question: Shivam starts his journey from point X and drives 12 km east. Then he turns left, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 5 km. Then he turns right and drives 2 km. Then he turns right and drives 7 km. Again he turns left and drives 10 km. Finally, he turns right and drives 10 km and stops at point Z. How far and in which direction should he drive to reach point X again? (All turns are 90 degrees unless otherwise specified)
solution:
Given: 

Shivam starts his journey from point X and drives 12 km east.

Then he turns left, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 5 km.

Then he turns right and drives 2 km.

Then he turns right and drives 7 km.

Again he turns left and drives 10 km.
